verdict.rationale: Lithic documents an official MCP server at docs.lithic.com/docs/mcp, which a probe confirmed. It connects to Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot and other AI editors to search docs, inspect endpoint schemas, generate code and execute live API requests. A first-party blog post shows agents creating cards and configuring auth rules through it. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use.
